text:
Maya: Quick flag from QA — when the notification banner appears while opening the settings modal the modal header nudges down ~10px. Happens in Chrome and Safari.
Eli: I see it. Banner is in flow right now, so it repaints the layout.
Sofia: a11y concern: keyboard users tabbing into the modal see the close button jump. Not great.
Maya: suggestion: render banners in a fixed UI layer, center-top, and keep them out of document flow. Also make them aria-live=polite.
Eli: CSS idea (tiny):
```css
.rw-banner { position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px); transition: transform .14s, opacity .12s; pointer-events: none; }
.rw-modal { z-index: 1000; }
```
Sofia: pointer-events none by default is good. ensure hover enables pointer-events so users can dismiss if needed. And audit icon-only buttons for aria-labels.
Maya: spacing nit: toolbar icons feel squashed when banner shows. Can we add a component-only token like --toolbar-gap-compact = 8px rather than editing global tokens?
Eli: yes — component token is safer. Also strengthen focus outline on icon buttons to 2px using --color-focus for light and --color-focus-inverse for dark.
Sofia: copy nit: some banners read "Saved" and others "Your changes were saved". Agree on short for banners, full form for dialogs. Add to content guidelines.
DevBot: PR opened: redwood/design-system#1102 — "banner: fixed layer + toolbar gap token + focus + copy" (assigned to Maya)
Maya: I'll include a small e2e: trigger banner while tabbing into modal and assert document.activeElement remains modal close button and header vertical shift < 6px.
Eli: I'll add a tiny note in DESIGN_TOKENS.md about z-order: base < content < banners < menus < modals < overlays so it's clear.
Sofia: Will run VoiceOver and NVDA checks once PR lands. Tagging @platform-ux for visibility. :thumbsup:
